# CSKA Auto Enterprise, workshop tools and equipment supplier in Singapore

> CSKA Auto Enterprise Pte. Ltd. (UEN 202127592M, incorporated 7 August 2021) supplies car workshops in Singapore with diagnostic scanners (THINKCAR THINKTOOL, Autel MaxiSys, TOPDON Phoenix), EV diagnostic tools, TPMS tools, Autel ADAS calibration equipment, SP ZONE car aircon flushing and recovery machines, battery testers, jump starters and power supplies, two-post lifts, jacks and stands, and workshop tools (Ingersoll Rand, M7, Lige, Stirling, ThreeBond). It is a business-to-business supplier that delivers each tool to the workshop and hands it over in person. Address: 101 Woodlands Avenue 12 #07-03B (Polaris @ Woodlands), Singapore 737719. WhatsApp: Steven Chai, Business Development Manager, +65 9822 2629; Kai Kiat (Ah Kiat), Sales Executive, +65 8493 0068; Alvis Kiew (Ah Yii), Technical Executive, +65 9037 2820. Email cskatrading20@gmail.com. Handover videos on facebook.com/chai.steven.393.
